execution: Pure V8 function evaluation on already whole-read immutable Git contents. No host, SDK, module or author verifier execution.

files_source.shape: input.files[path] = {raw: exact UTF-8 original text, blob: exact Git SHA1, bytes: UTF-8 byte count, sha256: SHA256 of UTF-8 bytes}

pin_map_shape: Each immutable tree's blob leaves mapped by exact path to {blob,bytes,sha256}; SHA256 is recomputed from whole bytes, not inferred from Git tree metadata.
exact_consumed_paths: result.public.json.used_files contains all 326 exact read paths and their full pins. All raw files are in the corrected390 tree except the explicit prior result path above.
hash_interface: Both helpers take an 8-bit byte string (each code point 0..255). UTF-8 text is encoded with unescape(encodeURIComponent(raw)); Git blob hash includes 'blob '+byteLength+'\0'+bytes.
